output.title: Dollar threshold for escalating a specialty pharmacy case to the pharmacy director
output.draft_text:
Question: What dollar amount sends a specialty case to the pharmacy director?

Answer: A specialty pharmacy case must be escalated to the pharmacy director when [cost measure used, e.g., the per-fill cost / annual projected cost / total claim amount] is [at or above / above] [dollar threshold]. Cases below this amount are handled by [role or team that reviews cases under the threshold].

How to apply the threshold:
1. Determine the [cost measure used] for the case using [system or source used to look up the cost].
2. If the amount meets the threshold, route the case to the pharmacy director through [escalation method, e.g., queue name, form, or email address].
3. Include [required documentation for escalation] with the referral.
4. Tell the member that the case is under additional review and that they can expect a decision within [number of business days / timeframe for director review].

Exceptions: [any exceptions, e.g., urgent or expedited cases, specific drugs, or plan types that follow a different threshold or path].

If you are unsure whether a case meets the threshold, contact [support contact or supervisor role].

Policy source: [name and number of governing policy document]. Effective date: [effective date].

author_checklist: Confirm the exact dollar threshold that triggers escalation to the pharmacy director.
Confirm which cost measure the threshold applies to (per fill, per month, annual projected, or total claim) and whether it is inclusive (at or above) or exclusive (above).
Confirm whether the threshold differs by plan type, line of business, drug, or client.
Confirm who handles specialty cases below the threshold.
Confirm the system or source advocates should use to determine the case cost.
Confirm the escalation method (queue, form, or contact) and the documentation required.
Confirm the expected turnaround time for director review and what advocates may tell members.
Confirm any exceptions, such as urgent or expedited cases.
Identify the governing policy document and effective date, and cite it as the source.
Confirm that the 'pharmacy director' is the correct title and role for this escalation.
